query: consumer sentiment index August preliminary final

results.content:
The University of Michigan updated its consumer sentiment index Friday with a preliminary August reading of 51, down about 8% from the final July index reading of 55.2.

The final August consumer sentiment index will be released on the 28th.

The school’s consumer sentiment tracker goes back decades and hit an all-time low in May. It had shown improvement across June and July before the downturn this month.
results.title: Consumer sentiment falls in August as Americans 'just don't feel like they're thriving'

results.content: The University of Michigan released its preliminary Consumer Sentiment Index for August at 10am ET on Friday, and the number landed well below expectations. The reading came in at 51 — against a consensus forecast of 54.5 and a July final of 55.2. That is a decline of roughly 8% in a single month, reversing two consecutive months of improvement.
